acceptance: `evolve backups verify --dir D` with a fixture bundle whose head is in main reports it contained and exits 0 (red: unknown command)
A bundle head found nowhere else exits 1 naming it
An applied patch is reported as applied; an unapplied one exits 1
fix: Add `evolve backups verify [--dir D]` (default: the hub's backups/). For each bundle it lists the heads and reports each as in origin/main, on another remote branch, or only in the bundle. For each patch it reports whether origin/main already contains it. It is read-only. Exit 0 when everything also exists elsewhere (safe to delete); exit 1 naming any head or patch that exists only in the backup; exit 2 on I/O. Document it in workspace-layout.md.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: The hub's backups/ directory holds .bundle and .patch files taken before risky operations, and nothing in go/ reads them. Before deleting one, the operator runs `git bundle list-heads` and a merge-base check of each head against origin/main, and `git apply --check --reverse` for each patch, all by hand.
title: Checking that backup bundles and patches are already on main before deleting them is `git bundle` and merge-base by hand; add `evolve backups verify`
